title: Cyberpunk 2077 FSR 4 - RX 9060XT + Ryzen 5 7600X | 100+ FPS with Path Tracing! PSYCHO SETTINGS!
description:
Cyberpunk 2077 is back and better than ever with Update 2.3 and FSR 4 Support, pushing next-gen visuals to the limit! In this video, we benchmark the game using the AMD RX 9060XT paired with the powerful Ryzen 5 7600X, delivering a stunning 200+ FPS with Path Tracing enabled.

This test showcases Cyberpunk in its full glory with ultra settings, ray tracing, and performance metrics for enthusiasts looking to build a high-end PC in 2025. Watch how this rig crushes Night City in 1440p and 1080p tests.

🔥 Specs Tested:
GPU: RX 9060XT
CPU: Ryzen 5 7600X
Game: Cyberpunk 2077 v2.3
Settings: Path Tracing / Ultra / DLSS / RT Overdrive
FPS Achieved: 200+ (1080p Ultra Path Tracing)
